# Pushary for Antigravity

Your Antigravity agent can send you a push when it has an update or ask you a question you can answer from your phone. If you opt in to phone calls, Pushary can ring you when an eligible question is still waiting.

## What you get after you sign in

1. Sign in and pick a plan. New customers start with a 3-day trial.
2. Install this plugin and sign in to the Pushary MCP server in Antigravity with the same account. There is no API key to copy.
3. When the agent needs a yes or an answer, the question arrives on your phone (the Pushary app for iOS and Android), on your Mac, or in the dashboard. A question asked through the connector stays open for 10 minutes.
4. You answer with one tap, or type a short reply, and the agent carries on. The dashboard keeps a record of what each agent asked and what you answered.

## Try one question

1. Use a Pushary Agent, Agent Pro or Team account. Sign in to the Pushary app on your phone and allow notifications.
2. Install the plugin in Antigravity. Open the Pushary MCP server in Antigravity and sign in with the same Pushary account.
3. Ask Antigravity to use Pushary to ask “Did this test reach your phone?” and tell you the answer you chose. Tap **Yes** or **No** on your phone.

## Approve tool calls in Antigravity CLI

The plugin lets the agent ask you a question. Antigravity keeps control of its native approval prompts. To have Pushary hold supported CLI tool calls before they run, follow the [Antigravity CLI setup guide](https://pushary.com/docs/agents/guides/antigravity-cli?utm_source=github&utm_medium=oss-adapter&utm_campaign=antigravity-plugin&utm_content=readme). It explains the separate hook setup, which actions it covers, and how to test approve, deny, and timeout in a scratch folder. Existing strict and organization-required reviews still apply.

[Compare Antigravity Remote Control, local alerts, and Pushary](https://pushary.com/antigravity-cli-notifications?utm_source=github&utm_medium=oss-adapter&utm_campaign=antigravity-plugin&utm_content=readme).

## Plans

Each plan starts with a 3-day trial for new customers. During the trial, Agent, Agent Pro and Team include 5 call minutes.

| Plan | Price | What you get |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Agent](https://pushary.com/pricing?utm_source=github&utm_medium=oss-adapter&utm_campaign=antigravity-plugin&utm_content=readme) | $9.99 a month | One person and every AI agent they run. Approve, deny or answer from your phone or Mac. 10 call minutes a month. |
| [Agent Pro](https://pushary.com/pricing?utm_source=github&utm_medium=oss-adapter&utm_campaign=antigravity-plugin&utm_content=readme) | $19.99 a month | Everything in Agent, plus unlimited notifications, budgets and priority support. 20 call minutes a month. |
| [Team](https://pushary.com/teams?utm_source=github&utm_medium=oss-adapter&utm_campaign=antigravity-plugin&utm_content=readme) | $59 a month for 5 people, $12 for each extra person | Each person gets their own agent’s questions. On supported hooks, route a step such as a production deploy to the teammate who approves it. See who answered in the shared record. Includes export and 60 shared call minutes a month. |

Missed the push? Pushary can call you, by default after 1 minute, and read the request. You approve it, say no or tell the agent what to do. Calls need a confirmed phone number and work in English, German, French and Dutch. [Phone calls](https://pushary.com/calls?utm_source=github&utm_medium=oss-adapter&utm_campaign=antigravity-plugin&utm_content=readme) · [Calls for Antigravity CLI](https://pushary.com/antigravity-cli-phone-call?utm_source=github&utm_medium=oss-adapter&utm_campaign=antigravity-plugin&utm_content=readme) · [How calls work](https://pushary.com/docs/agents/phone-calls?utm_source=github&utm_medium=oss-adapter&utm_campaign=antigravity-plugin&utm_content=readme)

## Data and access

The plugin connects to Pushary’s hosted MCP server at `https://pushary.com/api/mcp/mcp`. It ships no hooks or executable scripts. Pushary receives the information the agent sends in its requests. Keep credentials and private content out of questions and notifications.

## What is in this plugin

| Part | File | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MCP server | `mcp_config.json` | Connects Antigravity to Pushary's hosted MCP server |
| Skill | `skills/pushary-phone-check/SKILL.md` | Sends one test notification or question when you ask for a phone check |

## Related repositories

- [Pushary for Gemini CLI](https://github.com/Pushary/gemini-cli-extension): the same connector for Gemini CLI.
- [Pushary skill](https://github.com/Pushary/pushary-skill): the skill, and `npx -y pushary@latest setup` for approval hooks in Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Codex and more.
- [Pushary for Mac](https://github.com/Pushary/pushary-mac): answer from the notch on your Mac.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
